project: demo-calc, a tiny calculator library with a command-line interface
conventions: the patterns already in the code
worktree_note: Create each worktree with `git worktree add <git-root>/.worktrees/<lane> -b lane/<lane> main`. Branches are named `lane/<name>`. Each commit message is one plain sentence. Integrate by rebasing the lane onto main, running the gate, and fast-forwarding.
framework_note: No development framework is set up. A spec is whatever the user names.
implement_note: Make the change yourself against the spec.
